findings.why: `<anonymous>` at `/home/runner/work/lanterna/lanterna/examples/long-await/app.js:11` started an async timer resource that lived 256ms (~256ms waiting, 0ms on CPU). Long-lived async operations are usually slow I/O, network calls without a timeout, or promises waiting on something that already finished.
findings.suggestion: Open `/home/runner/work/lanterna/lanterna/examples/long-await/app.js:11` (`<anonymous>`) and add a timeout/abort path to this operation. Network and database calls should always carry a deadline (`AbortController`, axios `timeout`, `pg` statement_timeout, etc.).
